findings.summary: The comparator now distinguishes three safe cases: initial identity binding, unchanged identity across lifecycle-only descendants, and rotation to a verified new implementation only when old-to-new history contains non-task changes and new-to-parent history is task-artifact-only.
findings.broken_invariant: Compatibility evaluator facade requires independent review evidence.

findings.summary: Negative regression coverage rejects arbitrary identity substitution and task-artifact-only promotion; exact-SHA local full-fast and hosted PR verification pass.
